title: Fix Playground Play Styling
description: Playground puzzle 3d play (and siblings) look horribly unstyled: broken globals.css imports, missing main.ts CSS entry, redundant side-panel section labels showing tab ids, need design-system tokens and panel chrome like CAD play.
summary: Play sites were nearly unstyled: globals.css imported missing puzzle/core paths and main.ts never loaded CSS (~16KB bundle). Fixed all puzzle play globals to @ui/react/globals.css with full @source scan, added import ./globals.css to 2d/3d/5d main entries (~118KB tokens). Side panels no longer show slug section headers (content-only tabs use label:"", TreeSection skips useLabel when label is empty). Inspector/settings get human labels via SideTabSpec.label. UiRenderer form/tree chrome uses design-system spacing; PlaygroundPanelBody fills panel height.
